retrievalProfile.description: A gritty yet opulent urban aesthetic featuring chrome 3D lettering, desaturated street photography, and a picture-in-picture layout characteristic of early 2000s Southern rap covers.
triggerTerms: desaturated blue and tan color grading

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition combining a low-angle medium shot of two figures against a weathered urban backdrop, overlaid with heavy metallic 3D typography and a framed black-and-white inset image at the bottom center.
coreVisualRelationships: Large-scale figures in the upper half dominate the visual hierarchy.
Chrome typography acts as a horizontal divider between the main portraits and the lower urban scene.
A framed monochromatic inset provides a secondary focal point at the base.
Desaturated blues and tans create a unified, gritty atmosphere across disparate photographic elements.
coreInvariants: High-contrast chrome texture on primary text
Low-angle perspective on subjects to convey authority
Urban architectural background with repetitive geometric lines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two primary subjects occupy the top 60% of the frame in a medium-close-up, with one figure leaning forward into the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavy, reflective 3D title text centered horizontally across the middle of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the faces of the subjects, moves down to the metallic title, and settles on the framed inset at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with figures, architecture, and graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated navy blue and tan (clothing and skin tones).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool grey and white (urban architecture and sky).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the metallic reflections and shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to muted earth tones and industrial greys

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick 3D extrusion with a sharp upward perspective
Highly reflective chrome finish with simulated environmental mapping
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are blocky with minimal internal counters
Horizontal strokes are exaggerated in width
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair heavy 3D display type with a smaller, high-contrast stencil or sans-serif for subtitles.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory label in bottom corner

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary blocky weight for 3D extrusion
Matches the wide, industrial aesthetic of the era

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle photo of two men in urban streetwear standing in front of weathered apartment buildings, desaturated blue and tan tones, with a black-and-white framed photo at the bottom center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, centered 3D chrome title in an extra-bold wide sans-serif across the middle, and a smaller high-contrast subtitle below it.

verificationChecks: Is the main text rendered with a convincing 3D chrome effect?
Are the colors desaturated and gritty?
Is the composition centered and symmetrical?
Does the perspective feel low-angle and imposing?

adjustableVariables: Scale of the bottom inset image
mustRedesign: Do not use existing record label logos

mustAchieve: Clear hierarchical separation between text and image

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the chrome text doesn't obscure the subjects' faces.
Check that the 3D extrusion direction is consistent.
Verify the desaturated color grading is applied to all photographic layers.
Confirm the parental advisory label is placed in a standard corner position.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban portrait + 3D chrome typography + desaturated palette + architectural background = Bling Era Hip-Hop Aesthetic.
